test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 9 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

1. All keys are mouse.

2. Some mouse are processor.

3. Some processors are drive.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some processors are mouse.

II. Some processors are keys.

III. Some drives are mouse.

options.text: Both conclusions II and III follow

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as below,-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/58ddc6bf679e42e2459f51aa253b02a758430ed18a0d4448706852337ab5cac8.png] 

I. Some processors are mouse. → TRUE

II. Some processors are keys→. FALSE (it is possible but not definite)

III. Some drives are mouse.→ FALSE (it is possible but not definite)

Hence, "**ONLY CONCLUSION 1 FOLLOWS".**
